stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 38 pts for Glen White, top of the table and the sausage sizzle already fired up for the presentation.

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 4 & 8 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: The Plot Twist
stories.detail: Two wipes, one 4-pointer on holes 7, 8 & 9 - nobody ordered that

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: 15 on the back nine after 9 on the front - flying home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 82 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 5 off the pace with 1 to play

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Good to see Stephen Hunt up from Cootamundra CC, and we hope the greens were kind.

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 10, 11 & 12

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The One-Point Purist
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers, zero wipes - a very niche skillset

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 8, 9 & 10 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 9, 3-pointer on hole 10 - that's better

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 10 & 11 - the field is on notice

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 6 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 9 & 10 - this is momentum

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 5 wipes from 11 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 12 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 3 & 4 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Donating Points to the Course
stories.detail: 4 straight wipes - the course says thank you

stories.title: Caught at the Post
stories.detail: Led most of the day, run down to 4th at the death
